Linking scRNA samples to scATAC samples

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsankey)
library(stringi)
library(plotly)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(writexl)
```


# 1. Independent processing
## (1) import data
```{r}
# import data ~ 1.6 min
counts_Braun <- Read10X(data.dir= "./data_input/data_Braun_15-21")
gc()
counts_scRNA <- Read10X(data.dir = "./data_input/data_EHB_scRNA") 
gc()
counts_multiome <- Read10X(data.dir = "./data_input/data_EHB_multiome")
counts_multiome <- counts_multiome$`Gene Expression`
gc()

# split Braun into V2 and V3 chemistry
counts_Braun@Dimnames[[2]] <- sub("'","",sub("b'","",counts_Braun@Dimnames[[2]]))
counts_Braun_V2 <- counts_Braun[, !sub("_.*","",counts_Braun@Dimnames[[2]]) %in% c("10X177","10X178","10X298")]
counts_Braun_V3 <- counts_Braun[, sub("_.*","",counts_Braun@Dimnames[[2]]) %in% c("10X177","10X178","10X298")]
rm(counts_Braun)
gc()

# inspect data
dim(counts_multiome) # 36601 genes x 12700 cells
dim(counts_scRNA) # 33538 genes x 9909 cells
dim(counts_Braun_V2)  # 31915 genes X 71797 cells
dim(counts_Braun_V3)  # 31915 genes X 44317 cells
```

```{r}
# make Seurat object
Seurat_multiome <- CreateSeuratObject(counts_multiome, project = "10X_multiome")
Seurat_scRNA <- CreateSeuratObject(counts_scRNA, project = "10X_scRNA")
Seurat_Braun_V2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts_Braun_V2, project = "10X_Braun_V2")
Seurat_Braun_V3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts_Braun_V3, project = "10X_Braun_V3")

# calculate mito reads %
Seurat_multiome[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_multiome, pattern = "^MT-")
Seurat_scRNA[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_scRNA, pattern = "^MT-")
Seurat_Braun_V2[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_Braun_V2, pattern = "^MT-")
Seurat_Braun_V3[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Seurat_Braun_V3, pattern = "^MT-")

# add data source
Seurat_multiome$source <- "10X_multiome"
Seurat_scRNA$source <- "10X_scRNA"
Seurat_Braun_V2$source <- "10X_Braun_V2"
Seurat_Braun_V3$source <- "10X_Braun_V3"

# clean up
rm(counts_multiome, counts_scRNA, counts_Braun_V2, counts_Braun_V3)
gc()
```


## (2) QC
```{r}
# mito cutoff: 10% is good
summary(Seurat_multiome$percent.mt)
summary(Seurat_scRNA$percent.mt)
summary(Seurat_Braun_V2$percent.mt)
summary(Seurat_Braun_V3$percent.mt)

# filtering out low quality cells (empty droplets and doublets)
Seurat_multiome <- Seurat_multiome[, Seurat_multiome$nFeature_RNA >= 200 & Seurat_multiome$nFeature_RNA <= 5000 &
                                     Seurat_multiome$nCount_RNA <= 20000 & Seurat_multiome$percent.mt <= 10]
Seurat_scRNA <- Seurat_scRNA[, Seurat_scRNA$nFeature_RNA >= 200 & Seurat_scRNA$nFeature_RNA <= 5000 &
                               Seurat_scRNA$nCount_RNA <= 20000 & Seurat_scRNA$percent.mt <= 10]
Seurat_Braun_V2 <- Seurat_Braun_V2[, Seurat_Braun_V2$nFeature_RNA >= 200 & Seurat_Braun_V2$nFeature_RNA <= 5000 &
                                     Seurat_Braun_V2$nCount_RNA <= 20000 & Seurat_Braun_V2$percent.mt <= 10]
Seurat_Braun_V3 <- Seurat_Braun_V3[, Seurat_Braun_V3$nFeature_RNA >= 200 & Seurat_Braun_V3$nFeature_RNA <= 5000 &
                                     Seurat_Braun_V3$nCount_RNA <= 20000 & Seurat_Braun_V3$percent.mt <= 10]

# after filtering
dim(Seurat_multiome) # 12700 -> 12369 cells
dim(Seurat_scRNA) # 9909 -> 8915 cells
dim(Seurat_Braun_V2)  # 71797 -> 71349 cells
dim(Seurat_Braun_V3)  # 44317 -> 36593 cells
```

```{r}
# convert to a list
Seurat_RNA <- list(Seurat_multiome, Seurat_scRNA, Seurat_Braun_V2, Seurat_Braun_V3)
names(Seurat_RNA) <- c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA","Seurat_Braun_V2","Seurat_Braun_V3")
rm(Seurat_multiome, Seurat_scRNA, Seurat_Braun_V2, Seurat_Braun_V3)
gc()
```


## (3) DoubletFinder (our data)
Tutorial: https://github.com/chris-mcginnis-ucsf/DoubletFinder

```{r}
# step 1. normalisation and PCA (required for step 5)
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  print(x)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- NormalizeData(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) # counts -> tpm
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- FindVariableFeatures(Seurat_RNA[[x]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000) # usually 2000-3000
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- ScaleData(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) # scale data using variable features (intermediate step)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- RunPCA(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) # PCA on scaled data
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- DietSeurat(Seurat_RNA[[x]], assays = "RNA", layers = c("counts","data"), dimreducs = c("pca")) # remove intermediate scaled data
  rm(x)
}
```

```{r}
# step 2. elbow plot
p <- list()
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  p[[x]] <- ElbowPlot(Seurat_RNA[[x]], reduction = "pca", ndims = 50)
  rm(x)
}
p

# determine the true dimensionality of each sample
elbows <- c(9,14)
names(elbows) <- c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")
```

```{r}
# step 3. clustering (required for step 3)
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  print(x)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- FindNeighbors(Seurat_RNA[[x]], reduction = "pca", dims = 1:elbows[[x]])
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- FindClusters(Seurat_RNA[[x]], resolution = 0.6, algorithm = 4) # using Leiden algorithm; for v10 of the manuscript I compared multiple resolutions (0.1-1.2) and decided to use 0.6 for our data (two samples)
  rm(x)
}
gc()
```

```{r}
# step 4. pK Identification ~ 2.7 min
bcmvn <- list()
pK_best <- list()
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  print(x)
  sweep.res.list <- paramSweep(Seurat_RNA[[x]], PCs = 1:elbows[[x]], sct = FALSE)
  sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
  bcmvn[[x]] <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
  pK_best[[x]] <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn[[x]]$pK[which.max(bcmvn[[x]]$BCmetric)])) # best pK for each sample
  
  rm(x, sweep.res.list, sweep.stats)
  gc()
}

save(bcmvn, pK_best, file = "./data_rda/script2/pK_selection.rda")
```

```{r}
# step 5. Homotypic Doublet Proportion Estimate
nExp_poi <- list()
nExp_poi.adj <- list()
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  expected_doublet <- 0.05*0.6 # expected 10x scRNA doublet rate for ~5K cells is ~5%; and the QC filters have an expected doublet removal rate of 20-50%. I assume that there is still 60% doublets
  homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$RNA_snn_res.0.6)
  nExp_poi[[x]] <- round(expected_doublet*ncol(Seurat_RNA[[x]]))
  nExp_poi.adj[[x]] <- round(nExp_poi[[x]]*(1-homotypic.prop))
  rm(x, expected_doublet, homotypic.prop)
}
```

```{r}
# step 6. Run DoubletFinder (create artificial doublets) ~ 20s
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  print(x)
  # two rounds, with different classification stringencies
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- doubletFinder(Seurat_RNA[[x]], PCs = 1:elbows[[x]], pN = 0.25, pK = pK_best[[x]], nExp = nExp_poi[[x]], reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- doubletFinder(Seurat_RNA[[x]], PCs = 1:elbows[[x]], pN = 0.25, pK = pK_best[[x]], nExp = nExp_poi.adj[[x]], reuse.pANN = names(Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data)[grepl("pANN",names(Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data))], sct = FALSE)
  rm(x)
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
# step 7. remove doublets based on results from the second round of DoubletFinder
DoubletFinder <- data.frame()
for (x in c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")){
  Seurat_RNA[[x]]$doublet <- Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data[[ncol(Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data)]] # adjusted doublet inference
  DoubletFinder <- rbind(DoubletFinder, c(x, sum(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$doublet=="Singlet"), sum(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$doublet=="Doublet")))
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- Seurat_RNA[[x]][, Seurat_RNA[[x]]$doublet=="Singlet"]
  rm(x)
}
names(DoubletFinder) <- c("sample","singlet","doublet")
DoubletFinder
```

```{r}
# remove intermediate data for DoubletFinder
for (x in names(Seurat_RNA)){
  Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data <- Seurat_RNA[[x]]@meta.data[,c("orig.ident","nCount_RNA","nFeature_RNA","percent.mt","source","doublet")]
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- DietSeurat(Seurat_RNA[[x]], assays = "RNA", layers = c("counts"), dimreducs = NULL)
  rm(x)
}

# remaining cells
Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome # 12369 -> 12042 cells, 1 layer
Seurat_RNA$Seurat_scRNA # 8915 -> 8671 cells, 1 layer
Seurat_RNA$Seurat_Braun_V2 # 71349 cells, 1 layer
Seurat_RNA$Seurat_Braun_V3 # 36593 cells, 1 layer
```


## ------------- save -------------
```{r}
# save 3.8 GB ~ 1.5 min
save(Seurat_RNA, file="./data_rda/script2/Seurat_RNA_list.rda")
rm(bcmvn, DoubletFinder, nExp_poi, nExp_poi.adj, p, pK_best, elbows)
```



# 2. Atlas mapping
## (1) layer integration
Tutorial: https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/integration_introduction

```{r}
# rename cells to avoid issues when merging samples
for (x in names(Seurat_RNA)){
  colnames(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) <- paste0(x,"_",colnames(Seurat_RNA[[x]]))
  rm(x)
}

# combine data into one object
Seurat_combined <- merge(Seurat_RNA[[1]], Seurat_RNA[2:length(Seurat_RNA)])
Seurat_combined  # 38224 genes X 128655 cells
rm(Seurat_RNA)
gc()
```

```{r}
# pre-processing (applied independently for each layer, doing these after merging Seurat objects saves storage) ~ 1 min
Seurat_combined <- NormalizeData(Seurat_combined) # counts -> tpm
Seurat_combined <- FindVariableFeatures(Seurat_combined, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000) # usually 2000-3000
Seurat_combined <- ScaleData(Seurat_combined)  # using variable features by default
Seurat_combined <- RunPCA(Seurat_combined)  # using variable features by default
gc()

# align cell embeddings (pca) ~ 1 min
Seurat_combined <- IntegrateLayers(Seurat_combined, assay = "RNA", method = HarmonyIntegration,
                                   orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony_int") # HarmonyIntegration instead of CCAIntegration is preferred for large datastes (hours -> mins), and no need for scaled.data
gc()

# merge gene expression matrices (counts/data) ~ 50s
Seurat_combined[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Seurat_combined[["RNA"]])
gc()
```


## (2) UMAPs - integration
```{r}
# true dimensionality: elbow at 17
ElbowPlot(Seurat_combined, reduction = "pca", ndims = 50) # dimensionality is determined from the pre-integration pca space, not from the post-integration harmony space

# pre- and post-integration UMAPs ~ 1.8 min
Seurat_combined <- RunUMAP(Seurat_combined, dims = 1:17, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap_pre")
Seurat_combined <- RunUMAP(Seurat_combined, dims = 1:17, reduction = "harmony_int", reduction.name = "umap_post")
gc()
```

```{r}
# UMAP
DimPlot(Seurat_combined, reduction = "umap_pre", label = FALSE, group.by = c("source"), shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8)
DimPlot(Seurat_combined, reduction = "umap_post", label = FALSE, group.by = c("source"), shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8)
```


## (3) ct label transfer
```{r}
# get cell type labels in Braun dataset
Braun_ctAnnot <- read.csv("./data_input/data_Braun_15-21/ctAnnot.csv")
Braun_ctAnnot$CellID <- sub("'","", sub("b'","",Braun_ctAnnot$CellID))
Braun_ctAnnot$CellClass <- sub("'","", sub("b'","",Braun_ctAnnot$CellClass))

# match cell IDs
Seurat_combined$cell <- names(Seurat_combined@active.ident)
match_ID <- data.frame("seurat_ID"=Seurat_combined$cell[Seurat_combined$source %in% c("10X_Braun_V2","10X_Braun_V3")])
match_ID$orig_ID <- sub("Seurat_Braun_V3_","",sub("Seurat_Braun_V2_","",match_ID$seurat_ID))
match_ID <- merge(match_ID, Braun_ctAnnot, by.x = "orig_ID", by.y = "CellID")
rownames(match_ID) <- match_ID$seurat_ID
match_ID <- match_ID[Seurat_combined$cell[Seurat_combined$source %in% c("10X_Braun_V2","10X_Braun_V3")],] # fix cell order

# transfer cell type labels
Seurat_combined$ctAnnot <- NA
Seurat_combined$ctAnnot[Seurat_combined$source %in% c("10X_Braun_V2","10X_Braun_V3")] <- match_ID$CellClass
rm(Braun_ctAnnot, match_ID)
```

```{r}
# find neighbours ~ 15s
Seurat_combined <- FindNeighbors(Seurat_combined, reduction = "harmony_int", dims = 1:17, return.neighbor = TRUE)
gc()

# label transfer, based on 20 neighbouring cells ~ 2.7 min
labeltransfer <- data.frame()
for (x in Seurat_combined$cell[Seurat_combined$source %in% c("10X_multiome", "10X_scRNA")]){
  neighbors <- TopNeighbors(Seurat_combined@neighbors$RNA.nn, cell = x, n = 20)
  celltypes <- table(Seurat_combined$ctAnnot[neighbors])
  label <- names(which.max(celltypes[names(celltypes)!="unknown"]))
  if (is.null(label)) {label <- "unknown"}
  labeltransfer <- rbind(labeltransfer, c(x,label))
  rm(x, neighbors, celltypes, label)
}
  
# cell types
names(labeltransfer) <- c("cellID", "celltype")
Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer <- Seurat_combined$ctAnnot
Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer[Seurat_combined$source %in% c("10X_multiome", "10X_scRNA")] <- labeltransfer$celltype
table(Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer)  # unknown = 2951

# assign labels to the still "unknown"cells, iterate x2 until unknown = 0
for (x in names(Seurat_combined@active.ident)[Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer=="unknown"]){
  neighbors <- TopNeighbors(Seurat_combined@neighbors$RNA.nn, cell = x, n = 20)
  celltypes <- table(Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer[neighbors])
  label <- names(which.max(celltypes[names(celltypes)!="unknown"]))
  if (is.null(label)) {label <- "unknown"}
  Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer[x] <- label
  rm(x, neighbors, celltypes, label)
}
table(Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer) # all cells have labels

rm(labeltransfer)
```

```{r}
# UMAP - ctAnnot
DimPlot(Seurat_combined, reduction = "umap_post", group.by = c("ctAnnot_transfer"), shuffle = TRUE, raster=FALSE) + 
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8)
```


## ------------- save -------------
```{r}
# save 10.9 GB ~ 3.4 min
save(Seurat_combined, file="./data_rda/Script2/Seurat_combined.rda")
```

```{r}
Seurat_RNA <- Seurat_RNA[c("Seurat_multiome","Seurat_scRNA")]

```

```{r}
# pre-processing
for (x in names(Seurat_RNA)){
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- NormalizeData(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) # counts -> tpm
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- FindVariableFeatures(Seurat_RNA[[x]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000) # usually 2000-3000
  Seurat_RNA[[x]] <- ScaleData(Seurat_RNA[[x]])  # using variable features by default

ElbowPlot(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome, reduction = "pca", ndims = 50)
```

## (2) marker genes
```{r}
# cell type markers
ctMarkers <- c(
  "ZEB2","HOPX","CRYAB","PAX6","NES","HES2", # radial glia
  "SOX10","PAX3","SNAI2",  # neural crest
  "SOX2","HES1","NKX2-1", # neuronal IPC
  "NHLH1",  # neuroblast
  "LHX6","INA","RBFOX3","SYN1","MAPT","DCX","TUBB3","TBR1","FEZF2","SATB2","GAD1","PVALB",  # neuron
  "TNC","BCAN",  # GB
  "OLIG1","OLIG2","CNP","PDGFRA",  # OPC
  "AQP4","GFAP",  # astrocyte
  "CX3CR1","TREM2",  # microglia
  "ENG","PDGFRB","ACTA2",  # vascular
  "GYPA","HBA1","HBB",  # Erythroblast
  "VIM","FBLIM1","S100A4","FAP"  # fibroblast
)

# cell type marker dot plot
DotPlot(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome, features = ctMarkers, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.6") + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_scRNA, features = ctMarkers, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.6") + RotatedAxis()
```

```{r}
# get human TFs
Human_TF <- read.table("./data_output/Script1_ctAnnotation/Human_TF_v_1.01.txt", quote="\"", comment.char="")
Human_TF <- Human_TF$V1  # 1639 human transcription factors

# cluster markers ~ 25s
cluster_ctMarker <- list()
for (x in names(Seurat_RNA)){
  # differential analysis, returning all genes with logFC > 0.1 and p < 0.05
  Idents(Seurat_RNA[[x]]) <- Seurat_RNA[[x]]$RNA_snn_res.0.6
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(Seurat_RNA[[x]], test.use = "wilcox", logfc.threshold = 0.6, return.thresh = 0.05, min.pct = 0)
  
  # extract marker genes
  cluster_ctMarker[[x]] <- data.frame()
  for (y in unique(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$RNA_snn_res.0.6)){
    # (1) top 5 genes for each cluster
    marker1 <- paste(markers$gene[markers$cluster==y][1:5], collapse = " | ")
    
    # (2) top 5 cell type markers for each cluster
    markers_ct <- markers[markers$gene %in% ctMarkers, c("cluster","gene")]
    n <- min(5, sum(markers_ct$cluster==y)) # number of top genes
    marker2 <- paste(markers_ct$gene[markers_ct$cluster==y][1:n], collapse = " | ")
    
    # (3) top 5 TFs for each cluster
    marker3 <- paste(markers$gene[markers$cluster==y & markers$gene %in% Human_TF][1:5], collapse = " | ")
    
    # add cluster genes and and cell count
    nCell <- sum(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$RNA_snn_res.0.6==y)
    cluster_ctMarker[[x]] <- rbind(cluster_ctMarker[[x]], c(y, nCell, marker1, marker2, marker3))
  }
  names(cluster_ctMarker[[x]]) <- c("Cluster", "Cell Count", 
                                    "Top Cluster Markers", "Top Cell Type Markers", "Top Transcription Factors")
  cluster_ctMarker[[x]]$Cluster <- as.numeric(cluster_ctMarker[[x]]$Cluster)
  cluster_ctMarker[[x]]$"Cell Count" <- as.numeric(cluster_ctMarker[[x]]$"Cell Count")
  cluster_ctMarker[[x]] <- cluster_ctMarker[[x]][order(cluster_ctMarker[[x]]$Cluster),]
  
  rm(x, y, markers, markers_ct, n, nCell, marker1, marker2, marker3)
}

# check result
cluster_ctMarker
```

```{r}
# check and save
write_xlsx(list(multiome = cluster_ctMarker$Seurat_multiome, scRNA = cluster_ctMarker$Seurat_scRNA), 
           "./data_output/Script2_ctAnnotation/ctAnnot_RNA_raw.xlsx")
```


## (3) add annotation
```{r}
# import annotation
ctAnnot <- list()
ctAnnot[["Seurat_multiome"]] <- read_excel("./data_output/Script2_ctAnnotation/ctAnnot_RNA.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ctAnnot[["Seurat_scRNA"]] <- read_excel("./data_output/Script2_ctAnnotation/ctAnnot_RNA.xlsx", sheet = 2)
for (x in names(ctAnnot)){
  ctAnnot[[x]] <- ctAnnot[[x]][,c("Cluster","Cell Type")]
  ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster <- paste0("C", ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster)
  names(ctAnnot[[x]])[2] <- "CellType"  
  rm(x)
}

# add cell type annotations (C1 must be replaced in the second round)
for (x in names(Seurat_RNA)){
  Seurat_RNA[[x]]$clusters_fix <- paste0("C", Seurat_RNA[[x]]$RNA_snn_res.0.6)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]]$ctAnnot <- stri_replace_all_regex(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$clusters_fix,
                                pattern = ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster[!ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster %in% c("C1")], 
                                replacement = ctAnnot[[x]]$CellType[!ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster %in% c("C1")],
                                vectorize = FALSE)
  Seurat_RNA[[x]]$ctAnnot <- stri_replace_all_regex(Seurat_RNA[[x]]$ctAnnot, 
                                pattern = ctAnnot[[x]]$Cluster, 
                                replacement = ctAnnot[[x]]$CellType,
                                vectorize = FALSE)
  rm(x)
}
rm(ctAnnot)

# check annotation
table(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome$ctAnnot)
table(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_scRNA$ctAnnot)
```

```{r}
# UMAP
DimPlot(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("ctAnnot")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.4) + theme_void() + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14)) + ggtitle("")
DimPlot(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_scRNA, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("ctAnnot")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8) + theme_void() + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14)) + ggtitle("")
```

# 4. Compare methods
```{r}
# Method 1: ATAC-based
load("./data_rda/Script1/ArchR_Project.rda")
rm(EHB_10x_samples, ctMarkers, ctMarkers_class)

# Method 2: RNA-based label transfer
load("./data_rda/Script2/Seurat_combined.rda")

# Method 3: RNA-based cluster annotation
load("./data_rda/Script2/Seurat_RNA_annot.rda")
```


## (1) multiome - CS16
```{r}
# results from three ctAnnot methods
cell1 <- data.frame("cell" = sub("SINAG3#", "", getCellNames(ArchR_EHB[ArchR_EHB$ID=="FB-16"])),
                    "ATAC_cluster" = ArchR_EHB$ctAnnot_2.0[ArchR_EHB$ID=="FB-16"])
cell2 <- data.frame("cell" = sub("Seurat_multiome_", "", colnames(Seurat_combined)[Seurat_combined$source=="10X_multiome"]),
                    "RNA_atlas" = Seurat_combined$ctAnnot_transfer[Seurat_combined$source=="10X_multiome"])
cell3 <- data.frame("cell" = names(Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome$orig.ident),
                    "RNA_cluster" = Seurat_RNA$Seurat_multiome$ctAnnot)

# merge all three annotations
ct_merge <- merge(cell1, cell2, by = "cell")
ct_merge <- merge(ct_merge, cell3, by = "cell")
dim(ct_merge) # 8147 overlapping cells (high quality RNA and ATAC)
```

```{r}
# Sankey plot
sankey_df <- ct_merge %>% make_long(ATAC_cluster, RNA_cluster, RNA_atlas)
count_df <- sankey_df %>% dplyr::group_by(node) %>% tally()
sankey_df <- merge(sankey_df, count_df, by = 'node', all.x = TRUE)
names(sankey_df)[1] <- "celltype"
sankey_df$celltype <- sub("Erythrocyte","Erythroblast",sankey_df$celltype)
sankey_df$next_node <- sub("Erythrocyte","Erythroblast",sankey_df$next_node)
ct_order <- unique(sankey_df$celltype)

ggplot(sankey_df, aes(x=x, next_x=next_x, node=celltype, next_node=next_node, fill=celltype)) + 
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha=0.5, node.color="black", show.legend=T) + theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.title=element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.ticks=element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position.inside = c(0.93, 0.5)) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
rm(sankey_df, count_df)
```

```{r}
# calculate cell type porportions
ct_prop <- data.frame("method"="ATAC_cluster", proportions(table(ct_merge$ATAC_cluster)))
ct_prop <- rbind(ct_prop, data.frame("method"="RNA_atlas", proportions(table(ct_merge$RNA_atlas))))
ct_prop <- rbind(ct_prop, data.frame("method"="RNA_cluster", proportions(table(ct_merge$RNA_cluster))))
names(ct_prop)[2] <- "celltype"
ct_prop$method <- factor(ct_prop$method, levels=c("ATAC_cluster","RNA_cluster","RNA_atlas"))
ct_prop$celltype <- sub("Erythrocyte","Erythroblast",ct_prop$celltype)
ct_prop$celltype <- factor(ct_prop$celltype, levels=ct_order)

# Bar plot
ggplot(ct_prop, aes(x=Freq*100, y=celltype, fill=celltype)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) + guides() +
  theme_bw() + xlab("percentage (%)") + ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(~method, nrow = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1, size = 10), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "none")  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Freq * 100, 1)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35)))

rm(ct_prop)
```
